svg.title: MDT-GEN algorithm-level workflow
svg.desc: Combined algorithm flow for dataset curation, booking risk prediction, fetal abdominal circumference estimation, macrosomia monitoring, digital-twin state assembly, Neural ODE, CTGAN, and SHAP.
svg.text: Dataset curation → core risk and ultrasound algorithms → separate supporting research modules
0. Original cohort and how the booking predictors are defined
Clean and define outcomes: remove UID, 100%-missing thyroid field and duplicate LOS field; clean values, map GDM Yes/No, retain rows with known GDM outcome
Fill missing booking BMI from height and weight when available; macrosomia label is birthweight ≥ 4000 g
Curated predictor rule: use variables available at early booking (configured list, not automatic feature selection in model fitting)
8 static booking fields + 2 BP vitals → 10 predictors; exclude ID, diagnostic OGTT/glucose, and post-booking/delivery outcomes to avoid leakage

g.text: A. Early-booking risk models
10 booking predictors (no OGTT / glucose)
Age • gestational age at booking • BMI at booking • gravida • parity
Previous C-sections • deprivation rank • systolic BP • diastolic BP
Ethnicity
Numeric: 9 features | Categorical: ethnicity
Quality checks and fold-fitted preprocessing
Implausible booking GA, gravida and BP → missing
Median imputation • BP missingness flags • scaling • ethnicity one-hot
For each outcome: 5-fold out-of-fold stacking
Logistic Regression • Random Forest • XGBoost • CatBoost
Out-of-fold base probabilities → Logistic Regression meta-learner
Models then refit on training data; held-out validation reported separately
GDM booking model
P(GDM) risk estimate
Macrosomia booking model
P(birthweight ≥ 4000 g)
B. Ultrasound AC measurement
2D ultrasound frame or 6-sweep ACOUSLIC-AI case
Image pixel spacing: 0.28 mm/pixel
Attention U-Net segmentation
Resize / normalize → probability mask → threshold and keep largest component
Ellipse-based circumference measurement
Fit ellipse to contour → Ramanujan perimeter × pixel scale → AC (mm/cm)
Frame / measurement quality handling
Sweep: select 5 highest-confidence frames → median AC per sweep
Single frame: low confidence or missing scale suppresses derived outputs
Measured AC + confidence / plane quality
AC is a research image estimate; 0.28 mm/pixel is scale, not accuracy
C. Macrosomia monitor: booking probability + later ultrasound criterion
Stage 1: booking macrosomia probability
Booking model output is pre-test probability; top 20% flag informs moderate tier
Stage 2: only apply published criterion at GA ≥ 36 weeks
If AC and HC/BPD/FL available: Hadlock EFW ≥ 4000 g; otherwise AC ≥ 36 cm
One criterion only; no multiplication of correlated AC and EFW likelihood ratios
If Stage 2 applies: Bayesian odds update
Pre-test odds × published LR → post-test probability
Output: macrosomia tier + probability/context
High: criterion positive • Moderate: booking flag only • Low: neither • before 36 weeks: AC context only
Combined Stage 1 + Stage 2 probability is not validated on linked booking–scan–birthweight records in this project.
D. Available values for digital-twin state assembly
Maternal branch
Booking predictors + GDM / booking macrosomia risks
Fetal branch
AC, EFW when available, confidence / quality, gestational age
Risk / monitoring branch
Macrosomia monitor result and available history
Fused feature state for display / storage
Future use: a validated cross-modal model could combine these signals when linked data are available
OGTT / glucose values are excluded from booking predictors and the fused maternal feature vector.

svg.text: These branches are not inputs to the core prediction flow above unless explicitly shown in the project
